meta.title: Core: timeoutQueue to TS
meta.body_summary: Convert timeoutQueue library to TypeScript with a Set implementation, claiming minor performance improvement for floors and currency modules.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex converted timeoutQueue to TS with a Set claim; no performance evidence; PR closed without merge after 49 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 37656 changed lines, this PR is large by absolute volume, but most changes are from a large master merge (24k lines in package-lock.json). The actual performance-related change is a small library refactor (~60 lines). The PR was closed without merge, suggesting that the scale of extraneous changes or lack of evidence outweighed the core improvement.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review text; only bot comments reporting large numbers of linter errors from the merged master branch, which may have discouraged merging.
review_details.performance_claim: Using a Set may improve performance of timeoutQueue operations.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed without merge; one late approval without comment but PR remained inactive and was never merged.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple library refactor with a mild performance claim; agent produced a small code change but the PR included a large merge from master that introduced many extraneous changes and lint warnings, possibly making maintainers hesitant to merge. The PR languished for ~49 days before an approval, but it was never merged, indicating a process breakdown rather than technical rejection.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after data; performance claim is anecdotal.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix cycle; likely due to lack of performance evidence and large merge noise.

core_change_summary.description: Converted libraries/timeoutQueue/timeoutQueue.js to TypeScript (timeoutQueue.ts), replacing an array-based queue with a Set for improved performance, added a test spec, and deleted the old JS file.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The majority of changed lines come from a large merge of master branch, including 24k line changes in package-lock.json, diluting the performance change.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: optimize timeoutQueue with Set and add tests.
Merge master (large merge bringing many unrelated changes).
Convert to TypeScript: add .ts file, modify .js.
Delete old .js file after final merge.

review_signals.summary: Bot reported 101-115 linter errors added by the PR, many in unchanged files, likely due to the large merge.
Approved the PR with no review text, 50 days after creation.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with small timeoutQueue optimization and TS conversion.
Multiple bot comments flagging large number of linter errors from merged master branch.
No substantive human review feedback for ~49 days.
Late approval without comment; PR closed without merge, likely due to staleness and lack of performance evidence.
